newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cricket-Academy move to 159 for four against England A.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cricket-Academy move to 159 for four against England A.

text.p: Australian Cricket Academy batsmen Michael Dighton and Shawn Craig hit a partnership of 125 on Friday to steer their side out of trouble in the match against England A at Mount Gambier.
Dighton and Craig came together with the Academy at 34 for three and batted confidently before Craig fell to spinner Ashley Giles in the last over before tea for 64.
Dighton was 72 not out with the Academy's score on 159 for four.
